g.text: Title: 02 - INA228 current / voltage monitor circuit

g.desc: Title: 02 - INA228 current / voltage monitor circuit

g.text: Sheet: /02 - INA228 current / voltage monitor circuit/

g.desc: Sheet: /02 - INA228 current / voltage monitor circuit/

g.text: PROVISIONAL CIRCUIT / HARNESS DESIGN - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.desc: PROVISIONAL CIRCUIT / HARNESS DESIGN - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.text: J pin numbers are proposed harness assignments, not OEM connector pinouts

g.desc: J pin numbers are proposed harness assignments, not OEM connector pinouts

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Prototype may use an equivalent breakout, but check onboard shunt and pin labels before connecting it.

g.desc: Prototype may use an equivalent breakout, but check onboard shunt and pin labels before connecting it.

g.text: REAL IC PIN CONNECTIONS: INA228 / DGS 10-PIN PACKAGE

g.desc: REAL IC PIN CONNECTIONS: INA228 / DGS 10-PIN PACKAGE

g.text: C101 goes directly beside U101 VS/GND. A0=A1=GND selects 0x40; do not put another 0x40 device on the same bus segment.

g.desc: C101 goes directly beside U101 VS/GND. A0=A1=GND selects 0x40; do not put another 0x40 device on the same bus segment.

g.text: INA228 VS is 3.3V, NEVER battery voltage. Only VBUS and IN+/IN- connect to the high-voltage measurement path.

g.desc: INA228 VS is 3.3V, NEVER battery voltage. Only VBUS and IN+/IN- connect to the high-voltage measurement path.

g.text: Run SHUNT_HI / SHUNT_LO as a matched Kelvin pair from R101 sense terminals. Do not carry load current in those wires.

g.desc: Run SHUNT_HI / SHUNT_LO as a matched Kelvin pair from R101 sense terminals. Do not carry load current in those wires.

g.text: I2C pull-ups are on sheet 04, subject to existing module pull-ups. ALERT is open-drain and pulled up by R102.

g.desc: I2C pull-ups are on sheet 04, subject to existing module pull-ups. ALERT is open-drain and pulled up by R102.

g.text: Candidate shunt needs firmware calibration. Verify measurement range, reset behavior and power sequencing before use.

g.desc: Candidate shunt needs firmware calibration. Verify measurement range, reset behavior and power sequencing before use.

g.text: No input filter values are assumed. Evaluate TI input-filter guidance against actual converter / motor noise.

g.desc: No input filter values are assumed. Evaluate TI input-filter guidance against actual converter / motor noise.

g.text: Reference: TI INA228 datasheet, pin-function table and application circuit. Footprint intentionally awaits package verification.

g.desc: Reference: TI INA228 datasheet, pin-function table and application circuit. Footprint intentionally awaits package verification.
